Mismatched, duplicated and malformed chains are rejected; sign/verify collection preserves durable stage receipts. Use SDK emulator management with durable mutations, inventory reconciliation and resource leases. UUID/path/HDC-port binding remains subject to real running-instance acceptance. Running emulator binding verifies configured port or, only when unset, a loopback guest instance name plus unchanged UUID and instance path. Physical devices and mismatched endpoints are rejected. The lifecycle collector waits up to two minutes for the unique guest and verifies original inventory after deletion. This is a semantic review; acceptance still requires current compiled evidence for every mapped check.

No bundled agreement text is substituted for installed SDK evidence. This is a semantic review; acceptance still requires current compiled evidence for every mapped check.
